name: V3 analysis plan

B1.setting: tau2 airline, agent/user simulator/judge openai/aws/gpt-oss-120b via gateway :4113

B2.final_set: pending user choice; dated addendum required before any B2 final rollout

competitors: frozen by a registry line (experiments/configs/v3_B1_competitors.json) before the first B1 final rollout; candidates: ace, harnesslens, metaharness, wikiskill, mipro, trace2skill, gepa, gepafull, skillopt, evoskill
primary_family: each CapEvolve arm vs seed and vs each frozen competitor, one Holm per benchmark; m = 3 x (1 + n_competitors)
tests: artifact-level CR1 t(C-1), family clusters; pipeline-level t(S-1) with SE^2 = SE_task^2 + s_seed^2/S (5M-2)
infra: zero LLM errors: infra/gateway errors retried until success, never scored 0; candidate tool-consistency faults (5a) scored 0, counted, not retried
train_only: every search decision uses train data only; test ids never read during search
descriptive: search-time comparisons between CapEvolve arms and CapEvolve-arm vs CapEvolve-arm final contrasts are descriptive
